content: Local runtime admin console visual direction: restrained professional control panel, not marketing page or raw record browser. Use warm off-white page background with subtle grid texture, dark plum/ink text, muted secondary text, pale blush selected/primary controls, hairline borders, modest radii, light elevation, native system sans typography, moderate font weights, compact rectangular buttons/chips, and progressive disclosure for raw JSON. Approval pages should lead with the human review decision before exposing ids, digests, policy rules, and raw records.
